# React Native Boilerplate (TypeScript + Expo, built-in framework)

> Lean React Native app starter. The repo root is the Expo app; the framework lives in src/framework. Clean
> architecture, MVVM/MVI, typed DI, Redux Toolkit, REST/GraphQL/WebSocket, feature flags, i18n/RTL, design tokens,
> white-label brands, observability and AI tool calling, all integrated and tested.

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): commands, invariants, where code goes, skills
- [Getting started](docs/getting-started.md) · [Architecture](docs/architecture.md) · [Building features](docs/features.md)
- [Feature flags](docs/feature-flags.md) · [Configuration, build & release](docs/configuration.md) · [Brands](docs/brands.md)
- [Integrations](docs/integrations.md) · [AI](docs/ai.md) · [Decisions](docs/decisions.md) · [Troubleshooting](docs/troubleshooting.md)
- [Framework modules](src/framework/README.md)

Code entry points: src/app/bootstrap/bootstrapApplication.ts (composition root) · src/app/modules.ts (feature modules) ·
src/config/feature-flags.json (flags) · src/features/todos (reference feature) · src/app/bootstrap/adapters.ts (vendors)
